messages:
Sam: Quick sync on the embeddings/rerank preview table. When multiple vectors render the rows look very tight, feels like a dense data table. Thinking: per-view density toggle (Compact / Comfortable) so power users keep more rows, and accessibility folks get breathing room. @Liam @Margo thoughts?

Liam: Saw this in the mobile mock too. Per-view toggle sounds right. Compact default for desktop maybe, but Comfortable default for mobile and for users who enable high-contrast/large-text.

Margo: Agree on the toggle. Accessibility items: relevance cell needs an explicit aria-label like "Relevance score 0.82, high relevance" not just "0.82". Also tooltips should be accessible (focusable) and SVG badges must have aria-hidden when decorative.

Devin: On export headers: backend currently emits `embedding_vector` which is verbose. Suggest `embedding` (comma list), `relevance_score`, `id`, `source`, `text`. Also confirm CSV quoting for text fields that contain commas.

Sam: Nice. Proposed CSV header set: id,source,text,embedding,relevance_score. UI copy change: export modal currently "Download embeddings" 5; change to "Download embeddings (CSV)" to remove ambiguity.

Margo: Good call. Also add small hint under the export button: "embedding column: comma-separated floats, no brackets". For tooltips: Relevance header should read "Relevance (0-1)" with a tooltip explaining briefly how it's computed (dot product normalized).

Liam: For the table UX: Comfortable mode should increase row padding and show a 2px focus ring on cell focus. Also implement arrow-key navigation between cells and Enter to open a right-hand vector detail drawer. When drawer open, trap focus and close on Esc.

Devin: I'll coordinate with infra to change header names. Also adding an example CSV snippet to the docs helps reduce support tickets. Example: 

```
 id,source,text,embedding,relevance_score
 123,docs,"What is X?, more text","0.123,0.234,0.345",0.92
```

Margo: For near-duplicate detection can we show a micro-badge (icon) in the left-most cell? Should be aria-hidden with an associated tooltip "Potential duplicate". And color choice needs sufficient contrast per WCAG.

Sam: Accessibility nit: ensure table headers use <th scope="col"> and rows either have row headers or correct role attributes. We should run a quick a11y scan once the prototype is in.

AriaBot: accessibility-checker: missing-table-headers detected on branch `feat/vec-preview-density`. Recommend adding <th scope="col"> for all column headers. :warning:

Liam: Thanks @AriaBot. I'll add proper <th> markup and ensure keyboard semantics. Prototype will include both density modes and a11y-friendly focus styles.

Sam: One more copy thought: inline relevance values under 0.1 look like noise. Maybe render very low scores as "<0.1" visually but keep the full value in aria-label and CSV. That reduces visual clutter.

Devin: Fine with that visual. Backend keeps full precision for exports. I will ensure CSV contains full float.

Margo: Action items: write tooltip strings + aria-label templates, pick badge color tokens, and add duplicate badge tooltip copy.

Liam: Action items: build Compact/Comfortable toggle, implement arrow-key nav, proper <th> markup, and drawer focus-trap (due Thu).

Devin: Action items: change CSV header names in export API, add example to docs, ensure fields are quoted properly (due Fri).

Sam: I'll update Figma with Comfortable spacing and upload a small interactive prototype. Will ping here with the link and the test checklist. :thumbsup:
